description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) recipe for building and deploying U-Boot, a universal boot loader for embedded devices. It defines build dependencies, compilation and installation procedures, and deployment steps for various U-Boot components such as binaries, environment scripts, ELF files, SPL, and device tree blobs.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Handles the compilation of U-Boot, including configuration, building, and optional script image creation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs U-Boot binaries, environment scripts, ELF files, SPL, device tree blobs, and optional extlinux configuration into the target directory.
